items.t: HubSpot founder’s return could lift investor sentiment despite painful reset, Jefferies says
items.sum: Jefferies believes HubSpot (NYSE:HUBS)’s decision to bring back co-founder Brian Halligan as chief executive could restore investor confidence, although the transition is likely to involve difficult decisions and slower growth. items.t: HubSpot names new CEO, CFO in company ‘re-founding’
items.sum: The SaaS company brought back its former CEO of 16 years and named an Adobe finance leader to its CFO chair as it navigates ongoing AI pressures.

items.t: HubSpot stock rises 6% on sweeping CEO and CFO leadership overhaul
items.sum: Investing.com -- HubSpot Inc (NYSE:HUBS) shares rose 6.1% in premarket trading Thursday after the software provider announced a sweeping leadership overhaul, bringing back co-founder Brian Halligan as chief executive officer to spearhead an artificial intelligence-focused "refounding." Halligan replaces Yamini Rangan, who stepped down as CEO and exited the board of directors effective immediately,

items.t: HubSpot Co-Founder Brian Halligan Returns As CEO
items.sum: HubSpot (HUBS) stock surges as co-founder Brian Halligan returns as CEO to lead an AI transformation and the company reaffirms 2026 guidance.
